value.answer: This is most often a common cold, which usually clears in 7-10 days, though a cough can linger up to 3 weeks. I can't see your child, so watch for ear pain, a fever, or no improvement after 10 days.
value.triage: Call 811 for nurse advice if it lasts past 10 days, or if there's ear pain, fever, or poor drinking. Go to the ER or call 911 now for trouble breathing, ribs pulling in, blue lips, a stiff neck, or a child who is very sleepy or hard to wake.
